newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates shares keep rising in week.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates shares keep rising in week.

text.p: Most shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market rose in the week to Thursday, with high liquidity in the market and good demand, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week 23 points higher at 2,407.59 from 2,384.56 points.
A NBAD report said the increase was due to "the rise in the prices of the majority of the shares of companies and banks".
Shares of the new al-Khazna Insurance were the only ones that declined, falling to 300 dirhams from 350 dirhams. The share had clocked up major gains since its issue late last month at 100 dirhams.
There was good demand for bank shares, brokers said.
Union National Bank shares were up by a hefty 35 dirhams at 360 after gaining five dirhams the previous week. NBAD was up at 415 dirhams from 414.
Market leader, telecommunications company Etisalat rose five dirhams to 950 and Abu Dhabi National Insurance Company shares rose 10 dirhams to 965.
